2 · Privacy policy

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), we inform you about the processing of your personal data.

Data controller

Franco Giuseppe Zirotti — NIF X8913104Y, Costa Brava 20, 28034 - Madrid. Contact: franco@zirotti.com.

Data we process

Those you voluntarily provide through the contact form or via email, phone or WhatsApp: name, company, email address, service line of interest and the content of your message.

Purpose & legal basis

  • To respond to your enquiry and manage a possible commercial relationship — basis: your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) and pre-contractual measures (Art. 6.1.b).
  • No automated decision-making or profiling is carried out.

Retention

We keep your data for the duration of the relationship and thereafter for the applicable legal periods. Once no longer necessary, it is securely deleted.

Recipients & processors

We do not share your data with third parties except by legal obligation. Our email and web-hosting technology providers may access it as data processors, under contract. The contact form is sent through the FormSubmit service (formsubmit.co), which delivers the message to us by email.

This site loads no third-party resources: fonts are served from our own domain. The form provider (FormSubmit) may process the data you submit outside the European Economic Area; see its privacy policy at formsubmit.co.

Your rights

You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to franco@zirotti.com, stating the right you wish to exercise. You may also withdraw your consent at any time and lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

3 · Cookie policy

A cookie or local storage is a small file saved on your device when you visit the site. This site does not set cookies or use local storage: there are no technical, analytics, advertising or social-media cookies, so no consent notice is shown.

Third-party services

Fonts are hosted on this site itself; they are not loaded from Google Fonts or any other external server. Links to WhatsApp or LinkedIn take you to third-party sites with their own policies.

How to manage them

Although this site stores nothing on your device, you can delete or block cookies and storage from your browser settings:

  • Google Chrome
  • Mozilla Firefox
  • Safari
  • Microsoft Edge
